thread:
Self-Host Plausible: Great Analytics, but Mind the ClickHouse

Quick thread 🧵
> Plausible is a privacy-first, cookieless web analytics tool built in Elixir, and its self-hosted release is Plausible Community Edition (CE), which is free and AGPL-licensed.
Self-host it to own your analytics data and drop the cookie banner.

The important thing to plan for: Plausible stores its analytics events in ClickHouse, a separate analytics database, alongside PostgreSQL for configuration, so it is heavier to run than single-database tools like Umami.
That ClickHouse foundation is exactly why it stays fast on large traffic.
